spec_match.rationale: Compares [Clamp] unsigned long (WebTransportErrorOptions) with [Clamp] octet (WebTransportErrorInit) and applies draft-ietf-webtrans-http3 §4.4 mapping, with the reverse mapping as a round-trip check.

interactive.rationale: Typing or presets re-run both real constructors; the neighbouring-codepoint table re-renders.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature-index blurb promises exactly what the page delivers.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus 5158277221580800 and the relevant WebTransport spec section.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite has 9 assertions; on Chrome 153 2 pass (interface + default constructor) and 7 fail, so every behavioural assertion can fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome 153 headless: legacy card showed 255 for 70000 (rose 'lossy'), standard card showed TypeError; HTTP/3 code 0x52e4a410c368 for 70000. The wire codepoint is calculated, not observed — labelled on the page.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on change/preset only (not per keystroke) that live values equal the WebIDL clamp model.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables; amber is used for borders only (never text) because it misses 4.5:1 on stone.

accessibility.rationale: Preset buttons in a labelled list, input with described hint, polite status verdict, labelled table region with aria-current row.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: zero horizontal overflow, no control under 44px, every input labelled.

openQuestions.title: Observe the real RESET_STREAM code against a WebTransport server
openQuestions.detail: Sending writer.abort(new WebTransportError('', {streamErrorCode: 70000})) and seeing the peer receive the full 32-bit code needs a WebTransport (HTTP/3) server this site does not run. A server route would turn the calculated codepoint into an observed one.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment (project rule 7b); verification used headless Chrome via Playwright plus screenshots, and label/tap-target checks via DOM queries. Accessibility tree not inspected.

guidanceConsulted.query: number input with range validation accessible form controls
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label every field, describe constraints with aria-describedby, use inputmode for numeric entry.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Code fields are type=text inputmode=numeric/decimal (so out-of-range and fractional values reach the WebIDL conversion unmodified, which is the point of the demo) with hint text linked via aria-describedby.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive comparison table narrow mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with caption/th scopes inside a focusable role=region wrapper; stack into labelled cards on narrow widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Table wrapper has tabindex=0, role=region, aria-labelledby the caption; below 40rem rows stack with data-label pseudo-labels and the caption becomes block-level.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive comparison table narrow mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Intrinsic grid with minmax(min(100%, X), 1fr) so cards/fields wrap without overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Form grids and result cards use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 12-15rem), 1fr)); long values use overflow-wrap:anywhere.

summary: Clamp comparison and HTTP/3 mapping tool, verified on Chrome 153; wire observation needs a server.
